theorems.name: Submission.variation_deformation_vanish_off_closed
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), IsClosed K → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, x ∉ K → φ t x = x) → ∀ x, x ∉ K → initialVelocity φ x = 0 ∧ initialAcceleration φ x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (initialVelocity φ) x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (initialAcceleration φ) x = 0
